tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a)The bidder should have an average annual turnover of minimum INR 40 crores in the preceding continuous three financial years out of. FY 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25.a) Audited financial statements for last three financial years b) Certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Statutory Auditor on turnover details over the last three (3) audited financial years Bidder in case of Sole Bidder. Lead Bidder in case of consortium b)The Sole bidder or all of the members of the consortium, should have positive net worth as per the audited consolidated financial statements in each of preceding continuous three financial years out of. FY 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, Certificate duly signed by Statutory Auditor or Certificate from Chartered Accountant clearly stating the net worth.a)Startups to meet the pre-qualification criteria of prior turnover upto 50 percenatage of the financial turnover mentioned at 2(a) ie., average annual turnover of minimum INR 20 crores in any one of the last two preceding financial years i.e. FY 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25
